markets.title: Will Mexico win Mexico vs South Africa?
markets.rules_primary: If Mexico wins the Mexico vs South Africa professional FIFA World Cup soccer game originally scheduled for Jun 11, 2026 after 90 minutes plus stoppage time (does not include extra time or penalties), then the market resolves to Yes.
